content: Melvin-Koushki counts Ibn Turka's known oeuvre at 25 Persian and 19 (or 20) Arabic works (44 or 45 in total), a small Persian/Arabic dīvān, one ijāza and a body of correspondence including 58 letters, letter fragments and notes; twenty-two of the works have been edited or printed in some form. His list is based on Akram Jūdī-Niʿmatī's list in her edition of the Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr, supplemented and corrected.
